predictions.quote: I am extremely sure that we're less than a decade away from hard takeoff. predictions.quote: Digit V5 which is coming out later this year is the first time that a humanoid robot, a robot which is balancing, can step out of a work cell and does not need a physical barrier between the robot and the person to maintain safety in this warehouse.
predictions.prediction: Agility Robotics' Digit V5, launching later in 2026, will be the first humanoid robot able to work in warehouses without a physical safety barrier between it and human workers.
